fusions.name: A Bite From Each
fusions.desc: Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill gives one back. A ring around you that deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Turned on the Spit
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 13 damage, leaves the target [Stunned] for 1.2 seconds and [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds, and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Dishes Passed Round
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 5 tiles, and more the faster you cast.

fusions.name: Fed for the Road
fusions.desc: Each kill restores 3 health to you. When you kill an enemy, you also recover 2 stamina a second for 4 seconds, once every 6 seconds.
